copy.tagline: 将任务切片分组为风险优化的阶段并生成时间线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂项目拆分为风险可控的阶段并制定时间线。
copy.tagline_en: Group slices into risk-optimized phases with timeline generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex projects into risk-controlled phases and generate timelines.

howto.what: Claude 会收集每个切片的风险分数和GTM分数，计算优先级分数（分数越低越早发布），然后按规则分成三个阶段，生成ASCII格式的时间线，并列出每个阶段的验证检查点。
howto.when: 在Ask模式的Phase 2（CONVERGE）完成后，依赖映射和GTM对齐步骤已结束，即将进入Plan模式时。你也可以手动输入“use phasing skill”触发。

howto.what_en: Claude collects risk and GTM scores per slice, calculates a priority score (lower = earlier), groups slices into 3 phases based on criteria, generates an ASCII timeline with dependency arrows, and outputs checkpoints for each phase.
howto.when_en: During Ask mode Phase 2 (CONVERGE) after dependency-mapping and gtm-alignment, before switching to Plan mode. Can also be triggered manually with "use phasing skill".
